news.headline: X News: b14g Bitcoin staking protocol on Core loses about 97 million CORE in an unauthorized withdrawal
news.detail: Per the X News story, roughly 97 million CORE (about $1.36 million midday) moved to attacker-controlled addresses at 09:29 UTC; b14g paused its contracts, exchanges froze about 9 million CORE, staked BTC stayed safe, and CORE dropped about 8%. A post-mortem is promised.

news.headline: X News: Iron Fish shuts down after an inflation-bug exploit minted nearly 3 billion fake wIRON
news.detail: Per the X News story, attackers used a bug from a 2019 commit to mint nearly 3 billion wIRON (39 times real supply), bridged out and cashed about $197K, and the market cap fell from $200 million to about $2K. The team ended network support on 31 Oct.

news.headline: Robinhood Chain wallet repeating a create-token, pull-liquidity loop
news.detail: @HoodWhisp4663 (290 followers) says one wallet (0xB90c…A65A, per Blockscout) has run the same loop 1,206 times since 4 Sept: send 30.1 ETH to a new wallet, launch a token with about 30 ETH liquidity, remove liquidity about 45 to 55 minutes later, and return about 37 to 39 ETH. Low engagement so far (5 impressions); unverified claim.

news.headline: X News: Crypto investors demand doxxed founders amid rug pull fears
news.detail: Per the X News story, investors are swearing off projects without fully doxxed founders, citing data from 8.2 million token launches showing developers often grab early supply and exit fast, pocketing $579 million in profits, with 65% starting sales in the first minute.

news.headline: X News: Pump.fun's Halloween goat-costume post divides memecoin users
news.detail: Per the X News story, Pump.fun's Halloween photo was read as poking fun at its users as sacrificial goats or sheep; some took offense, others ran with it, including Kanki promoting a $Sheep token, and rival Baton posted its own squad costume.

news.headline: X News: FBI confirms North Korea's TraderTraitor group behind the record $6.3B Binance hack; Binance has replenished about 90%
news.detail: Per the X News story, the FBI confirmed on 31 Oct that North Korea's TraderTraitor group drained Binance hot wallets across chains in about 20 minutes around 29 Oct. Binance used its SAFU fund, futures insurance and treasury to buy back about 90% of assets, says BTC, ETH and USDT are fully backed, and plans to resume withdrawals on 1 Nov with full proofs by 3 Nov.
